metaTitle: Custom Heat Transfer Shorts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom heat transfer shorts in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Ideal for teams or events with full-color designs.
introHtml: Heat transfer decoration on shorts gives you the ability to print detailed logos, full-color graphics, or even photographic images directly onto the fabric. Unlike embroidery, heat transfers lie flat and can cover larger areas, making them ideal for promotional giveaways, team uniforms, or event staff apparel. Whether you choose cargo shorts for utility or athletic styles for movement, the transfer process ensures your design stays vibrant through repeated wear and washing.
heroAltText: Custom heat transfer shorts with full-color logo printed on the leg panel
